mapper.select: select * from ai_knowledge_document where status = 1 order by update_time desc, id desc
select * from ai_knowledge_document order by update_time desc, id desc
select * from ai_knowledge_document where status = 1 and doc_type = #{docType} order by update_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_knowledge_document (title, doc_type, source_type, source_id, content, status, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{title}, #{docType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
